content.title: Yau's pinching problem and vanishing of Betti numbers
content.abstract: We prove that a closed connected Riemannian $n$-manifold, $n\geq4$, satisfying $\sec>\frac{\operatorname{Scal}}{n(n+2)}$ at every point has vanishing real cohomology in degrees $1,..., n-1$. It is consequently a rational homology sphere if $n$ is odd or the manifold is orientable. Complex projective space shows that the coefficient is optimal and that the strict inequality is necessary in every even dimension. The required estimate for the Weitzenböck curvature term is established by integrating restricted Ricci operators over orthonormal frames and combining complementary degrees using Hodge
